principalStatement: Approved, push and procede to the next step.
scope: Freeze the finite SMA-Q1 synthetic scenario corpus before experimental results are observed.
Freeze semantic relevance, latency, reliability, contamination, partition, failure, buffering, and provenance thresholds.
Record required source, build, dependency, model, prompt, schema, and configuration identities and immutable execution prerequisites.
Record the approved semantic-memory-only authority boundary and stop conditions.
excluded: Executing SMA-Q1 scenarios or claiming an SMA-Q1 result.
Editing, committing, merging, pushing, cleaning, or stashing the shared dirty SMA checkout.
Starting, stopping, or reconfiguring OpenHands, SMA, Ollama, MongoDB, Qdrant, or launchd services.
Beginning SMA WP5, production rollout, historical-data use, or OpenHands-Q1.
Changing the released Teams contract or granting SMA workflow, process-control, audit, acceptance, or organizational authority.
releaseRule: Freeze and report the Step 14 preregistration candidate locally; do not push it without subsequent principal acceptance.
